summary: onTurnEnd(outcome, info) on AiChatProvider (config.onTurnEnd on <glirastes-chat>) is called once when a turn of the open chat ends, with its TurnOutcome and { sessionId }.
howTo: Pass onTurnEnd instead of diffing turnOutcomes to react once per finished, stopped or failed turn. It is not called at an open approval, for stored history, for a chat that is not open or after clear(). Without it nothing changes.
